correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

M3={(r,3-c) for r,c in T};put(3,11,14,M3)
def trans(S,refl=False,k=0):
 arr=[]
 for r,c in S:
  if refl:c=-c
  for _ in range(k):r,c=c,-r
  arr.append((r,c))
 mr=min(r for r,c in arr);mc=min(c for r,c in arr)
 return {(r-mr,c-mc) for r,c in arr}
